council_representatives.name: Lady Ilyra Vaelorian
council_representatives.description: Senior Vaelorian cousin and financial negotiator with knowledge of noble debts, trade agreements, and commercial obligations.

council_representatives.name: Thane Brokk Ironvein
council_representatives.description: Senior Kharadorn clan leader appointed by High King Durnak to represent dwarven interests.

council_representatives.name: Lady Ysabet Edarth
council_representatives.description: Edarth cousin and representative of several landed families. More flexible than Lord Garrick while defending traditional noble rights.

council_representatives.name: Ser Merek Veyr
council_representatives.description: Veteran frontier officer from a collateral Veyr branch focused on Northern Watch resources.

council_representatives.name: Lady Cassia Merrowen
council_representatives.description: Member of a powerful Merrowen maritime branch with ties to shipowners and merchants.

council_notes: The Imperial Council has six permanent seats, one appointed by each Great House.
The monarch presides but does not hold an additional Great House seat.
The Council is an aristocratic institution of negotiation and privilege, not a modern parliament.
Voting rules, quorum, vetoes, formal powers, and customary procedures remain unresolved.
